turn_text: Welcome to Advancing the Agenda. I'm your host, Michael Abramson. Today, I'll be continuing the series of interviewing candidates vying for the Republican nomination to be Governor of Georgia. I'll be following the same format as I have been with other candidates and asking the same questions, although the order may be different based on the flow of the discussion. My guest today is former United States Senator David Perdue. David Perdue is the original outsider. When first elected to the U.S. Senate in 2014, he was the only Fortune 500 CEO in Congress. He grew up in Middle Georgia, the son of two public school teachers, and paid his way through Georgia Tech by working factory and warehouse jobs. He has over 40 years of business experience leading the Reebok Athletic Brand and Dollar General stores, where he created thousands of jobs and helped working families make it from payday to payday. While at Dollar General, David served as Chairman of the National Commission on Literacy and Workforce Development. As an outsider, David is a champion for term limits and free market economic principles. Guided by his middle Georgia values, David has a proven record of getting results for Georgia. In the U.S. Senate, David secured funding to deepen the Port of Savannah, helped bring new missions to Georgia's military bases, and delivered disaster relief for Georgia's farmers. David is now running for governor to secure Georgia's elections, eliminate the state income tax, put parents back in charge of their children's education, and make Georgia's communities safe again. David, welcome to advancing the agenda.
